rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when “known” means famous or notorious.

example.english: They are known throughout the company.
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 hou2 ceot1 meng2

rows.note: Use this when a person, place, subject, or thing is familiar rather than simply publicly known.

example.english: I’m very familiar with this place; it’s well known to me.
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 go3 dei6 fong1 hou2 suk6 sik1

rows.note: Use this in written or technical contexts for information or facts that have been established or researched.

example.english: This experiment currently has only three known results.
example.traditional: 呢個實驗目前只有三個已知結果。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 sat6 jim6 muk6 cin4 zi2 jau5 saam1 go3 ji5 zi1 git3 gwo2

rows.note: Use this when something is accepted or recognized by people generally, especially as an established view or fact.

example.english: They are widely known as the best player.
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 gung1 jing6 ge3 zeoi3 gaai1 kau4 jyun4
